name: codex-sounds
description: Custom reply sounds, project soundscapes, and authorised YouTube-to-MP3 imports on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Reply sounds and project-specific ambient audio.
interface.longDescription: Play a sound after each Codex reply and assign looped WAV or MP3 tracks or folder playlists to Codex projects. Import authorised audio from a queue of YouTube URLs with local yt-dlp and FFmpeg tools. One controller owns the media handle, releases it when Codex closes, and supports a global mute shortcut. Windows x64. Audio paths and settings stay local to each workstation.
defaultPrompt: Open my sound settings in Codex.
Set up reply sounds on this workstation.
Assign a soundscape to this project.
Import authorised ambient audio from YouTube URLs.
